cards.headline: Nvidia board investigates CEO Huang over alleged Chinese spy tie
cards.summary: Nvidia opened an independent board investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang had a relationship with a woman US officials believe spied for China. Huang told staff he had an affair; Nvidia says he stays in his role and will cooperate.
cards.why_it_matters: Nvidia is central to US AI and chip export policy, and the probe adds uncertainty to a tech sector already hit by a selloff.

sources.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
Nvidia’s Huang admits to affair after allegations of relationship with Chinese spy
Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence

cards.headline: Iran gives US two days to accept its offer as Trump weighs strikes
cards.summary: Iran's foreign minister said Washington must accept Tehran's latest offer to end the war or face escalation. Trump told CNN he is 'highly unlikely' to renew attacks if talks show progress on the nuclear program and Hormuz, per The Hill.
cards.why_it_matters: The choice between a deal and renewed strikes affects oil prices, US troops in the region and the war's cost.

sources.title: Iran gives US two-day diplomacy ultimatum
Trump says he's 'unlikely' to renew attacks on Iran if talks show progress
Iran threatens to ‘rain down hell’ if US escalates war

cards.headline: Jeffries backs Hegseth impeachment; House vote possible this week
cards.summary: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries said he is a 'hard yes' on an impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, saying he abused his power. The Pentagon says Hegseth will not be deterred by 'phony investigations.' Axios reports GOP leaders brace for defections.
cards.why_it_matters: A House impeachment vote on a sitting Cabinet secretary would be a rare step and tests Republican unity after the midterm losses.

sources.title: Top House Democrat 'a hard yes' on impeaching Hegseth
House poised to impeach Pete Hegseth after GOP midterm defeat
Jeffries a ‘hard yes’ on Hegseth impeachment ahead of expected Massie resolution

cards.headline: Blanche backs DOJ probe of Democrats, won't rule out prosecutions
cards.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche said Democrats are threatening administration officials and backed Trump's call for a DOJ investigation. He declined to rule out prosecuting lawmakers who say they will investigate officials. Democrats describe their plans as routine oversight.
cards.why_it_matters: The dispute over Congress's oversight role and the Justice Department's independence will shape how divided government works.

sources.title: Blanche backs Trump call for DOJ investigation into Democratic impeachment push
Trump's AG won't rule out prosecuting Democrats who threaten to investigate

cards.headline: Deputy chief of staff Walters leaves as Miller reshapes White House
cards.summary: Deputy chief of staff Richard Walters is departing after Stephen Miller was named chief of staff. NPR says Trump's staffing changes signal how he may approach divided government. Rep. Marlin Stutzman, a Republican, called the Miller promotion a mistake.
cards.why_it_matters: Who runs the White House shapes how Trump deals with a Democratic Congress on spending, immigration and oversight.

sources.title: White House deputy chief of staff departs under Miller shakeup
Trump staffing changes post-midterms signal he's battle ready
Deputy White House Chief of Staff Richard Walters exits job ahead of Stephen Miller takeover

cards.headline: Blanche dismisses Means corruption claims as MAHA feud grows
cards.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche dismissed former health adviser Calley Means' corruption allegations against senior White House officials. A former FDA commissioner described pressure from tobacco lobbyists, and a Republican congressman called for scrutiny, Axios reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The dispute exposes a split inside the GOP over health policy and industry influence.

sources.title: Blanche dismisses Means allegations as GOP's MAHA feud deepens
Republican infighting mounts over corruption claims after midterms wipeout

cards.headline: White House says immigration crackdown will continue after midterms
cards.summary: The White House and Department of Homeland Security said they will keep up the immigration crackdown despite Republican midterm losses. The Guardian reports Trump is expected to refuse concessions to the new Democratic majority.
cards.why_it_matters: Immigration enforcement affects communities, employers and local governments, and may be a flashpoint with Democratic lawmakers.

sources.title: White House vows to keep up immigration crackdown after midterms defeat
Trump set to lurch further right, claiming US took ‘giant step back’ in elections

cards.headline: Group seeks Massie as Libertarian 2028 nominee
cards.summary: Axios reports a coalition wants to recruit outgoing Rep. Thomas Massie as the Libertarian Party's 2028 presidential nominee, betting that splits among Trump supporters could make a third-party bid a spoiler for the Republican nominee. Massie has not said he will run.
cards.why_it_matters: A third-party bid could affect the 2028 race and reflects strains inside the Republican coalition.

sources.title: MAGA castoffs plot 2028 spoiler bid

cards.headline: Democrats weigh Trump investigations; Sanders urges limits
cards.summary: The FT reports Democrats plan to pursue impeachments and probes of Hegseth, Elon Musk and Venezuelan oil deals. Sen. Bernie Sanders said Democrats should hold the administration accountable but 'cannot spend all of our time' on investigations.
cards.why_it_matters: How Democrats balance oversight against a legislative agenda on costs and health care will define the new Congress.

sources.title: Democrats vow to impeach Trump officials and investigate Republican donors
Sanders says Democrats should hold Trump accountable but 'cannot spend all of our time'

cards.headline: Slotkin won't commit to backing Schumer as Senate leader
cards.summary: Sen. Elissa Slotkin told Politico she would oppose Chuck Schumer as majority leader 'until I see a plan' and did not rule out a leadership challenge. Several incoming Democratic senators have also said they do not want Schumer as leader.
cards.why_it_matters: Leadership of the new Senate majority will determine how Democrats use their power over spending and nominees.

sources.title: Slotkin vows to oppose Schumer ‘until I see a plan,’ won’t rule out leadership challenge

cards.headline: Peltola leads Alaska Senate race by 637 votes
cards.summary: Fox News reports Democrat Mary Peltola leads Republican Dan Sullivan by 637 votes in the uncalled Alaska Senate race. Gov. Mike Dunleavy, a Republican, called the state's ranked-choice system 'very confusing.' Peltola's campaign has sued for rejected-ballot records.
cards.why_it_matters: The race could affect the size of the Democratic Senate majority.

sources.title: Dunleavy calls Alaska voting system ‘very confusing’ as razor-thin Senate race frozen in time

cards.headline: Democrats gained 500-plus state legislative seats, Politico says
cards.summary: Politico reports Democrats picked up more than 500 state legislative seats, with the count continuing, and flipped at least 12 chambers. NPR looked at North Carolina and Arizona to see what flipped legislatures may pursue.
cards.why_it_matters: State legislatures set policy on abortion, elections, taxes and energy, and draw district maps.

sources.title: Democratic thrashing redraws the map of state power
Historically red state legislatures have flipped. Here's what's on their agenda

cards.headline: Texas Republican urges special session before Hinojosa takes office
cards.summary: Rep. Brian Harrison urged Gov. Greg Abbott to call a special session restricting emergency powers before Democrat Gina Hinojosa is sworn in, Fox News reports. Axios calls Texas central to the future of US politics, immigration and AI.
cards.why_it_matters: Texas is the nation's second-largest state, and the power shift affects data centers, immigration and energy policy.

sources.title: 11th-hour power play targets incoming Dem governor after historic GOP defeat
Behind the Curtain: Texas is the #1 story of America

cards.headline: Mamdani says abolishing ICE is DSA's most palatable plank
cards.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani, a Democratic Socialists of America member, told Fox News that abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement is the DSA platform item most 'acceptable' to 'mainstream America.' Republicans have targeted DSA wins.
cards.why_it_matters: The remark shows the debate inside the Democratic Party over how far left to go on immigration enforcement.

sources.title: Mamdani: Abolishing ICE is the most 'acceptable' part of DSA platform to 'mainstream America'

cards.headline: Democrats see path to bypass Electoral College by 2028, Fox says
cards.summary: Fox News reports Democratic trifectas in swing states could push the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact past the 270 electoral votes needed to take effect. Gov. Josh Shapiro recently signaled openness to abolishing the Electoral College.
cards.why_it_matters: If activated, the compact would change how Americans elect presidents, ahead of 2028.

sources.title: Democrats’ midterm sweep opens path to bypassing Electoral College by 2028

cards.headline: Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies to form Israeli government
cards.summary: Gadi Eisenkot began coalition talks after President Herzog tasked him with forming a government, contacting allies of Benjamin Netanyahu. He warned Israel is approaching a 'point of no return' and, per Al Jazeera, is open to Netanyahu joining.
cards.why_it_matters: The outcome decides who leads a key US ally during the Iran war and Gaza talks.

sources.title: Gadi Eisenkot reaches out to Netanyahu allies as he strives to form government
Eisenkot open to Netanyahu joining Israel’s next government

cards.headline: Trump pressed Netanyahu to advance Gaza peace plan, Axios reports
cards.summary: Citing two sources, Axios reports Trump told Netanyahu in a Thursday call to take steps to implement his Gaza peace plan, which calls for disarming Hamas and demilitarizing Gaza. The White House has not commented in the article.
cards.why_it_matters: Gaza's ceasefire and reconstruction depend on this plan, and it ties into US-Israel relations.

sources.title: Scoop: Trump asked Netanyahu to move on Gaza peace plan in post-election call

cards.headline: Europe to join US-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi
cards.summary: France says European officials will attend this week's US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, defying Kremlin objections. It would be the first three-way round since February. Talks are set for Nov. 10-11.
cards.why_it_matters: European involvement could shape any deal on Ukraine's security and sanctions, which affect NATO allies and US commitments.

sources.title: Europe to join U.S.-brokered Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, defying Kremlin objections

cards.headline: Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant loses all outside power again
cards.summary: Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant switched to emergency diesel generators after losing its last external power line. The cause of the latest disconnection is unknown, according to The Hill.
cards.why_it_matters: Repeated power losses at Europe's largest nuclear plant raise the risk of a radiation accident.

sources.title: Ukrainian nuclear plant switches to generators after losing final power line

cards.headline: Houthi strike damages Aramco tower in Riyadh finance district
cards.summary: A Houthi attack damaged a landmark in Riyadh's financial district, including the Saudi Aramco tower, Bloomberg reports. It comes about a month after deadly strikes on the city's airport disrupted travel and canceled major events.
cards.why_it_matters: Attacks on Saudi Arabia's capital threaten Gulf energy infrastructure and investor confidence.

sources.title: Saudi Aramco Tower Targeted in Rare Strike on Riyadh Finance Hub

cards.headline: Iran executes three men over January protests
cards.summary: Iran executed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh for 'armed unrest,' the BBC reports. They were said to be part of anti-government protests earlier this year.
cards.why_it_matters: The executions show Tehran's domestic crackdown continuing during the war with the US.

sources.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests

cards.headline: Poland opens terrorism probe into Kraków shooting
cards.summary: Polish prosecutors opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old killed six in Kraków's market square; officials say far-right ideology probably inspired him. Two police officers who pursued him were injured and hailed as heroes.
cards.why_it_matters: The attack in a NATO and EU country raises concerns about far-right violence across Europe.

sources.title: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting
Two police officers hailed as heroes for confronting Kraków gunman

cards.headline: Train collision near Cairo kills seven, injures more than 100
cards.summary: Two trains collided in al-Ayyat, Giza province, killing seven and injuring over 100, officials said. Carriages derailed, and the conductor was among the dead. The president ordered a prompt investigation.
cards.why_it_matters: The crash is Egypt's latest deadly rail accident and raises safety questions in a major US partner.

sources.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven

cards.headline: Pope Leo arrives in Argentina amid tensions with Milei
cards.summary: Pope Leo XIV began the first papal visit to Argentina in nearly four decades, welcomed by President Javier Milei. The two differ on many issues, and Milei once called Leo's predecessor the 'representative of the Evil One,' per the Guardian.
cards.why_it_matters: The first US-born pope's trip tests relations with a libertarian government aligned with Washington.

sources.title: President Milei welcomes Pope Leo during historic visit to Argentina
After a successful trip to Uruguay, Pope Leo heads to Argentina

cards.headline: New Zealand election: National gets path back to power
cards.summary: NPR reports no clear winner, with weeks of coalition talks ahead and Prime Minister Christopher Luxon leading a caretaker government. Bloomberg says the National Party has a path back to power, lifting the New Zealand dollar.
cards.why_it_matters: The outcome affects policy in a close US ally and currency markets.

sources.title: No clear winner in New Zealand election, as leaders prepare for weeks of talks
New Zealand Dollar Advances as Ruling Party Gets Election Edge

cards.headline: Huawei goes on trial in New York over stolen tech and sanctions
cards.summary: Huawei, the world's largest telecoms firm, is on trial in New York, accused of stealing American technology and evading US sanctions, NPR reports. The outcome has global implications.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests US efforts to enforce tech sanctions on China and may affect US-China relations.

sources.title: The world's largest telecoms firm is on trial and the outcome has global implications

cards.headline: Treasuries get boost as election hits the AI trade
cards.summary: Bloomberg says Wall Street sees the Treasury market as a winner of the Democratic midterm landslide, giving traders a reason to rethink this year's sharp selloff. Asian markets may open under pressure from the Nvidia probe.
cards.why_it_matters: Bond yields drive mortgage rates and borrowing costs for households and the government.

sources.title: Treasury Rally Gets New Boost as Election Hammers the AI Trade
Asian Markets at Risk of Pressure on Nvidia Probe: Markets Wrap

cards.headline: US earnings beat estimates by narrowest margin in four years
cards.summary: MarketWatch reports S&P 500 companies are mostly topping analysts' profit estimates, but by the narrowest margin in roughly four years.
cards.why_it_matters: Thin earnings cushions leave stocks and retirement accounts more exposed to disappointment.

sources.title: Corporate America’s profit numbers are just barely beating Wall Street’s expectations

cards.headline: Latin America's Trump-linked trades face a Democratic Congress
cards.summary: Bloomberg says investors who priced Latin American assets by countries' standing with Trump now face a new variable: a Democratic-controlled US Congress.
cards.why_it_matters: US policy toward Latin America affects trade, migration and investments tied to the region.

sources.title: Democratic Sweep Tests Trump-Linked Trades Across Latin America

cards.headline: COP31 climate talks open Monday with host urging visible progress
cards.summary: Talks involving nearly 190 countries begin Monday. The host says the summit must deliver a tangible outcome people can see is real, as El Niño, supercharged by fossil fuels, shapes the backdrop.
cards.why_it_matters: The talks set the pace for emissions cuts and climate finance that affect energy costs and extreme weather.

sources.title: Cop31 must deliver climate progress that people can see is real, host says

cards.headline: Hundreds of thousands march in Amsterdam against Israel
cards.summary: Al Jazeera reports hundreds of thousands joined Amsterdam's 'Red Line' protest, seeking stricter trade restrictions on Israel and a halt to all arms sales.
cards.why_it_matters: The protest shows European public pressure on governments over Israel policy and arms trade.

sources.title: Hundreds of thousands join Amsterdam’s ‘Red Line’ protest against Israel

cards.headline: Labour expected to cut UK electric vehicle targets
cards.summary: The Guardian reports ministers are expected this week to make steep cuts to UK electric vehicle sales targets despite protests from some Labour MPs over climate commitments. Prime Minister Andy Burnham says he remains committed to the green transition.
cards.why_it_matters: UK targets influence global automakers' EV plans, including US firms selling in Britain.

sources.title: Labour expected to cut EV targets for UK’s car industry despite MPs’ protests

cards.headline: UK weighs banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
cards.summary: The UK culture secretary confirmed the government is 'looking seriously' at adding Vinted and eBay to platforms that under-16s would be banned from next March, the BBC reports.
cards.why_it_matters: The widening age limits could influence US tech and marketplace firms' policies abroad.

sources.title: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay

cards.headline: BYD's Dutch offices raided over Land Rover 'copycat' claim
cards.summary: Bailiffs acting for Jaguar Land Rover reportedly raided BYD's Dutch offices and seized digital records before a court case this week over whether a BYD model infringes intellectual property on the Land Rover Defender.
cards.why_it_matters: The case tests how Western automakers defend designs against fast-rising Chinese rivals.

sources.title: Chinese carmaker BYD’s offices in Netherlands raided over JLR ‘copycat car’ claim

cards.headline: Apple pushes to make Siri a more capable AI agent
cards.summary: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports CEO John Ternus is pressing AI chief Craig Federighi to speed up Siri's roadmap and deliver an agent competitive with OpenAI's and Meta's products, according to The Verge.
cards.why_it_matters: Siri upgrades affect hundreds of millions of iPhone users and Apple's position in AI.

sources.title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic

cards.headline: Elvis and Eminem rights holders sue AI music firm Suno
cards.summary: Rights holders of Elvis Presley's music and the publisher of Eminem's records sued Suno, claiming it illegally generates music and lyrics that mimic those artists. Suno faces other lawsuits.
cards.why_it_matters: The suits will help set limits on how AI can use artists' work.

sources.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno

cards.headline: Sequoia partners reportedly surprised by Botha's SpaceX board seat
cards.summary: TechCrunch reports Sequoia partners were blindsided when Roelof Botha joined SpaceX's board. The FT says the venture firm's new leaders closed its London office and a permanent capital fund.
cards.why_it_matters: Leadership changes at a top venture firm shape funding for startups.

sources.title: Sequoia partners reportedly blindsided when Roelof Botha joined SpaceX board
Sequoia’s new chiefs sweep away last remnants of Botha era

cards.headline: Amazon forms new home robotics team after Astro struggles
cards.summary: CNBC's analysis of job posts shows Amazon has formed a new home robotics team and is hiring for a 'new-to-world robot product,' even as its Astro home robot looks headed for the 'trash heap.'
cards.why_it_matters: A new Amazon robot could shape the consumer home robot market.

sources.title: Amazon's Astro home robot has fans but looks destined for the 'trash heap.' Why it's trying again

cards.headline: Gabon seeks $2 billion to revive Mabounié rare earths project
cards.summary: Gabon is seeking a $2 billion development of its stalled Mabounié niobium and rare-earth project with Emirati-backed New Energy Metals and Chinese engineering group ENFI, Bloomberg reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Rare earths are critical for electronics and defense, and China dominates supply.

sources.title: Gabon Seeks $2 Billion to Revive Mabounie Rare Earths Project

cards.headline: Cardiac arrest survival did not improve after responder training
cards.summary: A new study found survival after sudden cardiac arrest did not improve with advance training of bystanders and emergency responders. Researchers are not ready to rule out benefits, STAT reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Public CPR training programs are widespread, so evidence on what saves lives guides health spending.

sources.title: Survival after sudden cardiac arrest didn’t improve despite training bystanders, emergency responders

cards.headline: Physicists use electrical noise to probe superconductor mystery
cards.summary: Researchers listened to electronic noise to tell whether electrons in a superconductor have paired up, helping crack a long-running puzzle, Ars Technica reports.
cards.why_it_matters: Understanding superconductors could eventually lead to more efficient power grids and electronics.

sources.title: Physicists listened to electrical noise to crack a superconductor mystery

cards.headline: Young mathematicians solve 55-year-old juggling-inspired conjecture
cards.summary: A group of young mathematicians solved a conjecture first inspired by juggling, found through randomness and friendship, Wired reports. The title notes it was solved by humans, not AI.
cards.why_it_matters: It shows human researchers still solving long-open math problems amid the rise of AI.

sources.title: A 55-Year-Old Math Problem Was Solved—This Time by Humans

cards.headline: NASA opens $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge
cards.summary: NASA announced a $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge at Kennedy Space Center, inviting US high school and post-secondary student teams to contribute designs for a lunar base.
cards.why_it_matters: The contest feeds the US push to return to the Moon and build a workforce.

sources.title: NASA Announces $1 Million to Students for Moon Base Challenge

cards.headline: 3D printing and drones fuel return of antipersonnel mines in Ukraine
cards.summary: New Scientist reports 3D printing, microcontrollers and drones have enabled a resurgence of antipersonnel mines in the Russia-Ukraine war, making them deadlier and more accessible.
cards.why_it_matters: Cheap, easily built mines could spread beyond Ukraine and threaten civilians for decades.

sources.title: Antipersonnel mines have returned in Ukraine and now threaten the world
